member.name: M:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder.AntiforgeryApplicationBuilderExtensions.UseAntiforgery(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder.IApplicationBuilder)
member.summary: Adds the anti-forgery middleware to the pipeline.

remarks.para: The middleware validates anti-forgery tokens only for HTTP POST, PUT, and PATCH requests. Requests using other HTTP methods are skipped.
If you need validation for other HTTP methods (for example, DELETE), resolve and call or in your handler.

When using HTTP method override middleware configured to read the method from a form field before this middleware, an incoming POST request can be overridden to another method. Anti-forgery validation still runs when the effective method is POST, PUT, or PATCH, but does not run automatically when the override changes the request to a different method outside that set (for example, DELETE).

member.param: The .
member.returns: The app builder.
